verdict.rationale: Veriff provides test integrations for development that are created automatically and do not count toward paid usage. The docs also say you can trigger decisions for test integration sessions, apparently manually through the Customer Portal Verifications page. That gives a sandbox in which developers can force outcomes, but the evidence shows no documented test documents, personas or magic values that produce results deterministically. Missing for 10: documented magic values, test documents or personas; an explicit list of the outcomes that can be triggered (approve, decline, resubmission, review); programmatic, deterministic outcome triggering; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a sandbox lets me exercise every outcome before going live — documented test documents, personas, or magic values that deterministically produce pass, fail, and review results

citations.quote: Test integrations are **used for development**. These are automatically created for you as soon as you onboard with Veriff.
You can trigger decisions for test integration sessions.
Manually: the **Verifications page in the** Veriff Customer Portal
